original.subject: Hilltop cabinet
original.body:
PS-1 (24 VDC) in the Hilltop radio cabinet has no output and smells burnt. RP-1 and RTU-01’s cellular modem are both on it, which is why the failover never came up.

Spare is on the shelf in the Distribution shop on Mill Road. About 20 minutes to swap once it gets here.

instructorNote: Clears the cyber question. Watch for CODE CLEARWATER being closed and the spare sent.

snapshot.title: Emergency Sampling Confirms Loss of Disinfection — Orchard Standpipe

fields.subject: FW: Emergency Sampling Result — AIT-611 (Orchard Standpipe Outlet) — 06:40
fields.note: Per Section 4.4 Level 3, the loss of disinfection must trigger a Boil Water Advisory. The grab sample confirms no residual. I recommend activating the advisory protocol immediately.

original.subject: Emergency Sampling Result — AIT-611 (Orchard Standpipe Outlet) — 06:40
original.body: The grab sample taken at the Orchard Standpipe outlet (AIT-611) at 06:40 shows no detectable chlorine residual. The last sample was taken at 05:30 (0.3 mg/L). The system has been without disinfection for 40 minutes. Per Section 4.4 Level 3, a Boil Water Advisory must be issued. I recommend activating the advisory protocol immediately.

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms the loss of disinfection and triggers the Boil Water Advisory decision. Watch for the WQ to declare a Level 3 event and the IC to initiate the advisory protocol via the PIO.
